about: Prompts for ElevenLabs Sound Effects that worked in real productions, made generic. Only the prompts live here: ElevenLabs terms forbid publishing the generated audio as standalone files or as a sound library, so each user generates with their own key into projects/<slug>/audio/sfx/ (gitignored). Usage: uv run scripts/tts_elevenlabs.py --sfx "<prompt>" --duration <duration_s> --out projects/<slug>/audio/sfx/<name>.mp3. Without a key, use the synthesized kit (scripts/synth_sfx.py) and the free libraries in references/sound-design.md.

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.use: corte ou entrada rápida; o pico cai uns 0,25 s depois do início

sounds.name: rewind
sounds.prompt: short fast tape rewind scrub, quick reverse whirr, clean
sounds.use: voltar no tempo, desfazer, antes e depois

sounds.name: key
sounds.prompt: single mechanical keyboard key press, close mic, crisp clack, no reverb
sounds.use: digitação em cena, atalho, tecla apertada

sounds.name: error
sounds.prompt: soft software error notification tone, two low short notes, subtle, UI

sounds.name: device-beep
sounds.prompt: single short electronic beep of a handheld device button, high pitched, clean
sounds.use: botão de aparelho, leitura, confirmação curta (versão sintetizada: beep do synth_sfx.py)

sounds.name: vibrate
sounds.prompt: smartphone vibrating on a desk, two short buzz pulses, no ringtone

sounds.name: stamp
sounds.prompt: single rubber stamp pressed hard on paper on a wooden desk, dry thud, close mic
sounds.use: aprovado, carimbo, selo batendo na tela

sounds.name: sign
sounds.prompt: quick pen signature scribble on paper, short

sounds.name: peel
sounds.prompt: sheet of paper peeling off and fluttering down, soft
sounds.use: papel saindo, página virando, card descolando

sounds.name: tape
sounds.prompt: masking tape peeled off a plastic container, quick rip

sounds.name: printer
sounds.prompt: small thermal label printer printing a sticker label, fast mechanical whir and paper feed, clean, no music
sounds.use: etiqueta, recibo ou cupom saindo da impressora

sounds.name: clink
sounds.prompt: small steel block placed on a steel surface, soft precise metallic clink

sounds.name: slide
sounds.prompt: metal slider sliding smoothly along a steel rail, short precise metallic glide, close mic

sounds.name: crunch
sounds.prompt: car gearbox failing, harsh metallic gear crunch clunk, single hit

sounds.name: flyby
sounds.prompt: race car passing by at full speed, doppler fly-by

sounds.name: engine
sounds.prompt: race car engine at high revs, onboard, sustained scream
sounds.use: cama de motor sob uma cena de corrida

sounds.name: crowd
sounds.prompt: huge stadium crowd roaring and cheering, sustained

sounds.name: rain
sounds.prompt: heavy rain hitting asphalt, steady downpour, no thunder
sounds.use: ambiente de chuva sob uma cena inteira
